variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Variables are defined by pushing a literal name (starting with /) and a value, then calling 'def'.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: Dynamically typed. Supports numbers, booleans, strings, arrays, dictionaries, and executable procedures.

operators.title: Operators
operators.code:
1 2 add % 3
5 2 sub % 3
3 4 mul % 12
10 2 div % 5.0
1 1 eq  % true
operators.notes: Stack-based RPN syntax, similar to Forth.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: 'if' and 'ifelse' consume a boolean and one or two procedure blocks.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: The 'for' operator takes a starting value, step, limit, and a procedure to execute.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: 'loop' iterates a procedure infinitely until 'exit' is called.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Functions are simply executable arrays (procedures) bound to a name in the dictionary.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.code:
/arr [1 2 3 (four)] def
arr 0 get % gets 1
arr 1 42 put % sets index 1 to 42
arrays.notes: Arrays are enclosed in brackets. 'get' and 'put' are used for element access.

maps.title: Maps
maps.code:
/dict 2 dict def
dict /Key1 (Value1) put
dict /Key1 get % (Value1)

% Alternatively:
<< /Key (Value) >>
maps.notes: Dictionaries act as maps. Created with 'dict' operator or using << ... >> syntax.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: 'stopped' executes a procedure and pushes a boolean true if it was halted prematurely (e.g., via 'stop' or an error).

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: PostScript provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: PostScript supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: PostScript provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: PostScript converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: PostScript represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: PostScript formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: PostScript branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: PostScript defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: PostScript iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: PostScript organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: PostScript stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: PostScript groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: PostScript tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: PostScript organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
